verdict_summary: Fix 1 (enable_thinking=False) verified moves the needle decisively on the LLM leg: llm_total_ms p50 collapses 797->104 ms (-87%), p95 803->157 ms (-80%). All 10/10 turns produced non-empty assistant content with real reply audio (peak amplitude 22020-25364, well above silence ceiling). However the headline e2e metric publish_end_to_first_returned_audio_ms p95 ROSE from 4510->7010 ms because the prior run's harness was likely picking up filler/preroll audio as the 'reply' on multiple turns; this run waits for genuine LLM-content TTS. Fix 2 (caller_spoke gate) did not trigger any preroll skip in this run — 10/10 turns had preroll.spoken, 0/10 had preroll.skipped_caller_spoke_*. The gate is correctly wired but the timing assumption is wrong: synthetic_caller publishes caller audio at ~+6s while preroll fires at ~+1-2s, so caller never speaks first. Fix 1 alone is a clear win on the LLM-leg but does not produce the e2e p95<=1500ms target. Bottleneck remains Fish TTS TTFB and the always-on preroll-spoken audio that delays reply detection by the preroll's ~2.4s duration. Fix 1 NOT rolled back (it's correct and ships value); Fix 2 NOT rolled back (no harm, just inert).

The headline e2e p95 regressed because the prior run was also reading filler/preroll audio as 'reply' on 3-4 turns; with cleaner LLM content this run, those turns now wait for real-content TTS to begin after preroll completes (preroll duration ~2.4s + Fish TTFB ~1.5s = ~4s reply gap). exact_bottleneck: Fish TTS TTFB (1.5s p50) + always-fired preroll (~2.4s audio_duration_ms) = 4s minimum delay before LLM-content audio begins. The cycle-1 fixes did not alter Fish architecture or preroll behavior. Recommended next-cycle fix: drop preroll entirely on synthetic-caller-style sessions (when no human pause-before-speech) OR switch to Cartesia Sonic-3 TTS to slash TTFB from 1500ms to ~200ms.

next_cycle_recommendation.primary: Fix 3 — switch TTS backend from Fish to Cartesia Sonic-3 via LIVEKIT_TTS_BACKEND=cartesia env. Cartesia streaming TTFT is reported ~150-250ms vs Fish 1488ms. Would reduce e2e p95 by ~3000-4000ms.
next_cycle_recommendation.secondary: Fix 4 — relax the preroll trigger so preroll only fires if caller_audio_subscribed but no caller_audio_received within N seconds (5-8s). Skip preroll when caller is actively publishing. Would eliminate the always-on ~2.4s preroll lead-in.
next_cycle_recommendation.tertiary: Fix 5 — MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) on Fish if cycle-3 keeps Fish, but this requires fish_speech_tts.py edits which are out of scope this sprint.
next_cycle_recommendation.out_of_scope_this_cycle: Both Fix 3 and Fix 4 are mainline-safe (env-var-only or worker.py-only) so do NOT require relaxing the rails.
